title: Bedrock turns land on the AWS meter
description:
Feature: Bedrock billed via AWS
  As a Chatticus operator
  I want Bedrock inference on the AWS meter and never as vendor dollars
  So that tokens are counted once and the invoice is not double-counted

  Scenario: A Bedrock turn records billed_via aws and null cost
    Given the deployment has Bedrock enabled
    And vendor price for model "anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5" is 2.00 input and 4.00 output per million tokens
    And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a channel with a named bot "Assistant"
    When user "ryan" of tenant "anthus" posts "hello" addressed to bot "Assistant" on the channel using model "bedrock/anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5"
    And bot "Assistant" runs one computerless worker turn for the selected model
    Then the vendor ledger row for the turn has billed_via "aws"
    And the vendor ledger row for the turn has null cost_usd

Parent check: closes the parked rule in f3c786 once the live adapter writes this row.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
A Bedrock turn writes the vendor ledger with `billed_via=aws` and `cost_usd` null. The adapter/outcome chooses the meter; the worker does not hard-code it.

Gherkin scenario in `features/turn_model_selection.feature` is green. This also satisfies parked task `f3c786`.

Product PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/348
